raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Register two Triton data movement parity tests in AMD 1-GPU PR CI:

- `test_gdn_fused_split_head_ratios.py` (6s) compares the GDN QKV split with PyTorch slicing across head ratios; its helper has a HIP path.
- `test_vocab_parallel_embedding.py` (13s) compares the Triton lookup with `torch.nn.functional.embedding` across dtypes, token IDs, and weight layouts.

Both tests run without a model or server. The active AMD small suite grows from 91 to 93 entries (+19 estimated seconds); the NVIDIA registrations are unchanged.

## Test plan

- [x] Registration lint and AST collection with `sanity_check=True` (91 → 93 AMD small entries)
- [x] ROCm 7.2.4 targeted AMD suite: passed; GDN split 7s, vocab embedding 16s ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36011566126))
- [x] ROCm 7.2.0 targeted AMD suite: passed; GDN split 6s, vocab embedding 18s ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36011595784))
- [x] ROCm 10 targeted AMD suite: passed; GDN split 8s, vocab embedding 16s ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36011616989))
- [ ] NVIDIA Base CI: automatic run stopped at the missing `run-ci` label gate; test jobs were skipped ([run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/36011365978))
